name: download-hub
build: tmp=$(mktemp -d /var/tmp/download-hub-build.XXXXXX) && trap 'rm -rf "$tmp"' EXIT && git archive HEAD | tar -x -C "$tmp" && cd "$tmp" && npm ci --no-audit --no-fund && npm test && npm prune --omit=dev --no-audit --no-fund && tar -czf "$OUT/app.tar.gz" package.json package-lock.json src views public node_modules

health.cmd: curl -fsS --max-time 3 http://127.0.0.1:3000/health | grep -q '"ok":true' && curl -fsS --max-time 5 -o /dev/null http://127.0.0.1:3000/ && sleep 3 && [ "$(systemctl show -P NRestarts download-hub)" = 0 ]
